The storage uses string keys. I need to convert them using the table's `document_id_class` in preview.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'EOF'
import re
src = open('tinydb/journal.py').read()
old = """        data = self._db.storage.read()
        sim = copy.deepcopy(data.get(self._table_name, {})) if data else {}"""
new = """        data = self._db.storage.read()
        raw = data.get(self._table_name, {}) if data else {}
        # Storage may keep document IDs as strings (e.g. JSON); convert
        # them to the table's document ID class for the simulation.
        sim = copy.deepcopy({
            table.document_id_class(doc_id): doc
            for doc_id, doc in raw.items()
        })"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('tinydb/journal.py', 'w').write(src)
print('patched')
EOF
python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('/testbed/tinydb/journal.py').read()); print('syntax ok')""}
